description: Defines interfaces and constants for the WPEFramework's composition system, including screen resolutions, client interfaces, rendering, display, and brightness controls.

classes.name: IComposition
classes.description: Interface for managing display composition, including resolution, opacity, z-order, and client management.

classes.name: IComposition::IClient
classes.description: Represents a client surface within the composition, with properties like geometry, opacity, and z-order.

classes.name: IComposition::IClient::IProperties
classes.description: Properties of a client surface, including stride, format, offset, and modifier.

classes.name: IComposition::IRender
classes.description: Interface for rendering operations such as scan-out.

classes.name: IComposition::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for attachment and detachment events.

classes.name: IComposition::IDisplay
classes.description: Represents a display device, allowing creation of clients and resolution management.

classes.name: IBrightness
classes.description: Interface for managing brightness settings related to SDR and HDR display modes.

classes.name: IBrightness::Brightness
classes.description: Enumeration for different brightness modes in HDR displays.

methods.name: IComposition::RefreshRateFromResolution
methods.description: Calculates refresh rate based on screen resolution.

methods.name: IComposition::WidthFromResolution
methods.description: Returns width for a given resolution.

methods.name: IComposition::HeightFromResolution
methods.description: Returns height for a given resolution.

methods.name: IComposition::ResolutionFromHeightWidth
methods.description: Determines resolution enum from height and width.

methods.name: IBrightness::SdrToHdrGraphicsBrightness
methods.description: Gets or sets the SDR to HDR graphics brightness mode.
